least-common-multiple.label: First positive shared time
least-common-multiple.description: For positive integers a and b, the least common multiple L is the smallest positive integer divisible by both. If two signals begin together and repeat every a and b minutes, L is their first positive reunion time. Divide ab by their greatest common divisor d to avoid counting the shared factor twice.

perfect-number.label: Proper-divisor tile total
perfect-number.description: A positive integer is perfect when the sum of its positive proper divisors equals the integer itself. List the divisors smaller than n, make one counted strip for each divisor, and compare their combined length s with the target n. The balance Δ=s−n distinguishes deficient, perfect and abundant numbers.
